title: An exact dual makes every horizontal current nonnegative
statement: For fixed identical rung g at every column, KCL gives -D2J_k+g H R_k J_k=0, k1..L, J0=J_(L+1)=I e_s, with H the row-path Laplacian. Diagonal blocks2I+gHR_k and off-diagonal -I form an irreducible matrix with nonpositive off-diagonals, zero internal column sums and positive end sums. The supplied minimum principle on its transpose gives inverse>=0, hence J_i,k>=0; summing gives sum_iJ_i,k=I. This is the explicitly declared uniform-transverse structure, not arbitrary varying rungs or a recovered producer model.
